title: A valid-looking oversized duration panics instead of returning an error
prompt: parse_duration panics for the input '18446744073709551615s1000ms', although oversized durations should return DurationError::NumberOverflow. Splitting the extra second into '999999999ns 1ns' has the same problem. Fix this behavior while preserving representable durations near the limit and ordinary duration parsing. Add regression coverage and keep the existing suite passing.
regression_provenance: Upstream commit adds the two reported overflow assertions to its existing duration tests.
